no state, PE, LBO, Super League or relocation link

sponsors 2026-27: Temporal (software) front of shirt replacing NET88 (betting); Chexx Bet (gambling) sleeve with Selhurst Park LED/backdrop branding (single-outlet report of the September 2026 announcement) - the sleeve was already counted in V 6.0; Macron kit; Molson Coors

no FA/UEFA discrimination sanctions found 2021-26; UEFA fines 2025-26 were for anti-UEFA chants and 'UEFA mafia' banners (disrepute, not discrimination); FA fined the club GBP 50,000 in February 2026 for a Holmesdale banner about Nottingham Forest owner Evangelos Marinakis (offensive banner, not discrimination)

community: Palace for Life Foundation active; academy (Mitchell, Wharton-era pathway) already counted

Woody Johnson: 2020 State Department inspector general report recorded staff complaints of insensitive remarks on race, religion and sex while he was US ambassador; the department's Office of Civil Rights later found the allegations unsubstantiated - not counted
notes: V stays 6.0: the WSL return is a real women's-team positive (about +0.2), but the Chexx Bet deal now includes stadium branding and the FA banner fine is a minor conduct negative; together they roughly offset. name: Columbus Crew

changes.why: In April 2026 the Crew's ownership group (Haslam Sports Group, Nationwide, the Edwards family) was awarded an NWSL expansion team for 2028 ($205m fee, shared stadium refurbished for it, new training facility), a real women's-team commitment not in the earlier V evidence; counted modestly because it does not play until 2028.

missing_checked: betting: Tipico was 'official and exclusive sports betting partner' from 2022 (beer garden and club naming at the stadium); the club's current partners page lists no sportsbook or casino (Ohio Lottery is a partner, a lottery not a sportsbook, treated as Philadelphia's PA Lottery was)
kit clean: Nationwide shirt; stadium renamed ScottsMiracle-Gro Field (from Lower.com Field) for 2026

ownership change: Edwards family to 30% in 2025; Nationwide (Columbus-based mutual insurer) agreed in May 2026 to buy 37% (30% from the Haslams, 7% from the Edwards) at a $900m valuation, announced June 2026; Haslams keep control at 40%. MLS approval not separately confirmed. More local ownership, consistent with O 7.2
no PE, state, LBO or multi-club link (Haslam Sports Group's other teams are the NFL Browns and a Milwaukee Bucks stake, not football clubs)
no MLS fan discrimination or violence sanctions found
Derrick Jones and Yaw Yeboah lifetime betting bans (March 2026) concern former players; club not implicated (already noted in Team research)
notes: For Kevin: the controlling owners, Jimmy and Dee Haslam, gave Deshaun Watson a fully guaranteed $230m contract at the Browns in 2022 while he faced more than 20 civil suits alleging sexual misconduct; Haslam later called the trade 'a big swing and miss' but stood by the decision. This is owner conduct at another franchise, which no existing rule covers (the nearest is Arsenal's rival-ownership line). If Kevin wants it counted under Ownership, about -0.3 (O 7.2 to 6.9) would fit; not proposed because the new Nationwide stake moves the club the other way. current_r3 shows H 7.4 while scores.py has 7.2; H not re-judged here.
